name: SunRay Rockledge 2-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna HL200LX
description: Description The SunRay Rockledge 2-Person Traditional Indoor Sauna combines durable hardwood construction with an elegant cultured stone interior. It includes a 4.5 kW Harvia electric heater with digital controls, designed to provide traditional steam sauna heat up to 170°F. The Rockledge features ergonomic seating with a backrest, a stereo system with MP3 capability, LED star lighting, and multiple convenience features. Compact yet refined, it is designed for comfort, relaxation, and the many health benefits of traditional sauna bathing.
